tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the user's alcostore cart by SKU. Works for signed-in and anonymous users; the cart is created automatically on first add. Alcohol can only be sold to adults (18+). The user must be of legal age; ID is verified at delivery. Requires a delivery address; if this tool returns address_required, call set_delivery_address. Availability and prices depend on the delivery address.

sku.description: Product SKU, e.g. "A0023673" (from search_products or view_product).

quantity.description: How many units to add. Positive integer, default 1, max 50.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List alcostore product categories. Without parentKey returns the top-level categories; with parentKey returns its direct subcategories. Use list_category_products to browse the products of a category. Category keys can be browsed on the site at /kategorie/{key}. Requires a delivery address; if this tool returns address_required, call set_delivery_address. Availability and prices depend on the delivery address.

parentKey.description: Optional category key whose direct subcategories should be listed, e.g. "nabial".

tools.name: list_category_products
tools.description: List the products of a alcostore category with pagination. Use list_categories to discover category keys. Returns products with prices, availability and slugs usable with the view_product and add_to_cart tools. Requires a delivery address; if this tool returns address_required, call set_delivery_address. Availability and prices depend on the delivery address.

categoryKey.description: Category key, e.g. "nabial" — from list_categories results.

offset.description: Number of products to skip — use for pagination, e.g. offset=10 with limit=10 for the second page (default 0).

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the alcostore alcohol catalog by free-text query. Returns matching products with prices, availability and slugs usable with the view_product and add_to_cart tools. Works for signed-in and anonymous users. alcostore sells alcoholic beverages — all products are restricted to adults (18+). Requires a delivery address; if this tool returns address_required, call set_delivery_address. Availability and prices depend on the delivery address.

offset.description: Number of results to skip — use for pagination, e.g. offset=10 with limit=10 for the second page (default 0).

tools.name: set_delivery_address
tools.description: Set or change the delivery address. If no address is set yet, opens the address dialog for the user to confirm one (it cannot be set autonomously); if an address is already set, reports that and makes no change. A delivery address is required before the other tools work.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.description: Read the user's current alcostore shopping cart: line items with quantities and prices, plus the cart total. Requires a delivery address; if this tool returns address_required, call set_delivery_address. Availability and prices depend on the delivery address.

tools.name: view_product
tools.description: Fetch full details of a alcostore product by its slug (e.g. from search_products or category listings): price, promotion, availability, ingredients, allergens and other attributes. Requires a delivery address; if this tool returns address_required, call set_delivery_address. Availability and prices depend on the delivery address.

slug.description: Product slug in the form {SKU}-{name-kebab-case}, e.g. "A0023673-zott-jogurt-naturalny".
